subject.title: feat(skill-workshop): add restore action for quarantined proposals and display scan findings

question: Should a restored proposal with a still-non-clean scan become editable in pending state while Apply remains fail-closed, or should the lifecycle use a distinct remediation state?
rationale: The implementation separates proposal workflow status from security scan state, which is reasonable for remediation but changes the established meaning of quarantine and requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Approve editable pending
options.body: Allow restoration to pending for revision and rejection, while documenting and testing that backend Apply always rescans and fails closed until clean.

options.title: Add remediation state
options.body: Introduce a distinct editable remediation status so pending continues to imply a clean, applyable proposal.

options.title: Require clean restore
options.body: Keep the proposal quarantined unless the refreshed scan is clean, which requires another supported mechanism for editing quarantined content.

recommendation.title: Approve editable pending
recommendation.body: Allow restoration to pending for revision and rejection, while documenting and testing that backend Apply always rescans and fails closed until clean.

likelyOwner.reason: This cross-cutting Gateway and security-state contract needs repository-level product and security ownership.
